highlights:
## 📒 A log of everything Nod did

Open **Usage** and each request reads in plain words, like _Gmail: send email_ or _Change a schedule_. Select one to see every step behind it: each model call and its cost, each click on a website, and the words that allowed each action. **Export** downloads the full log as a CSV, even when it runs to hundreds of thousands of steps. Or just ask "What did you do today?" in the app, Telegram or WhatsApp. [Spending and usage](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/use/spending/)

## ▶️ Run a schedule right now

Every saved schedule has **Run now**. It runs once with the same instruction, shows progress and opens the result. The next scheduled time stays where it was. [Schedules](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/use/schedules/)

## Also in this release

- **Approvals:** The yes/no question is built from the exact action, so what you approve is what runs. Deleting an email shows its subject and sender first.
- **Questions about Nod:** Nod reads its own docs before answering and links the section.
- **Sign-ins:** If a sign-in ends with an unknown result, **Check sign-in result** has Nod look at the website before asking for another entry.
- **Telegram and WhatsApp:** If messages stop, **Reconnect** on Channels restarts delivery with your saved settings.
- **Long work:** The status line says what Nod is doing instead of filler words. A new task gets one acknowledgement, not two.
- **Local models:** Ollama, LM Studio and other servers get the full 30 minutes to start answering.
- **Long pastes:** Messages over 100,000 characters stay in the composer with a tip to shorten them or attach a file.
- **Windows:** Uninstalling from **Settings → Installed apps** works again after you update.
